description: List the sections and field names the CIA World Factbook carries for a country (e.g. Economy → "Real GDP per capita", "Inflation rate (consumer prices)", "Exports - partners"). Use before factbook_compare to find the exact field to ask for. Defaults to the United States profile, which carries the full field set.

country.description: Country name or ISO code. Default "United States".

name: factbook_fields
